meta.source: IBTrACS v04r01 (Knapp et al. 2010; NOAA NCEI), main tracks
meta.wind: max sustained wind in knots x 0.5144; USA_WIND (1-min) if the storm has any, else WMO_WIND
meta.near: max over fixes within radius_km of Vietnam's land; null if none of those fixes has a wind value
meta.light_share: share of Vietnam's 2025 night-light radiance in 0.05-degree land cells whose centre lies within 100 km of the track where the storm is at least 34 kt (track inside the map window, densified every 10 km, wind interpolated linearly between fixes; segments next to a fix without wind are skipped)
